resources.string: CSV backups are not encrypted and contain glucose, insulin and alert data. Choose your own folder, e.g. Documents/MGlikemia. The files survive app uninstall. After reinstalling, select the folder and restore the backup before enabling saving. Folder access depends on its provider; a cloud folder may synchronize your data.
The folder is not empty. Restore the backup it contains first, or choose an empty folder. No file was overwritten.
No access to the backup folder. Select it again and restore the backup, or choose an empty folder.
The backup operation failed. Check that the folder is reachable and has free space. The last verified backup was not overwritten during rotation.
The setting could not be saved. Backups are paused for this session; check the setting after restarting the app.
